name: GeoLLM-QA
description: GeoLLM-QA is a benchmark designed to evaluate tool-augmented large language models in remote sensing applications by capturing long sequences of verbal, visual, and click-based actions on a real UI platform. It includes 1,000 diverse tasks reflecting realistic user-grounded scenarios.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark in remote-sensing multimodal evaluation that is gaining attention in tool-augmented LLM research, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Focuses on realistic user interactions in remote sensing platforms, including verbal, visual, and click-based inputs.
